references.text: The prophet Zechariah speaks of a time of great conflicts and wars, which reflects the warning Jesus gives in Matthew 24:6 about hearing of wars and rumors of wars.
Ezekiel describes a time of war and destruction, corresponding to Jesus' words in Matthew 24:6 that disciples will hear of wars.
Jeremiah speaks of nations hearing about war, which parallels what Jesus says in Matthew 24:6 about hearing of wars and rumors of wars.
This verse continues the theme from Matthew 24:6, with further details about the events that will occur before the end times.
Luke gives a parallel description to Matthew 24:6, where Jesus warns that wars and disturbances will come.
In Revelation, it is described how war will break out, which resonates with Jesus' warning in Matthew 24:6 about wars and rumors of wars.
